sede_switcher.label: Active branch
sede_switcher.only_one: You only have one branch; create another in Settings → Branches to switch.
sede_switcher.no_targets: No other branch available to copy to.

form.unsaved_changes: You have changes that haven't been saved yet. If you close this form, they'll be lost. Leave without saving?

errors.forbidden_body: You do not have permission to view this page.

impersonation.banner_body: You are operating in {{restaurant}} with your superadmin account. End support mode when you are done.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to view this section, or the current context does not allow it.
forbidden.helper: If you believe you should have access, ask a restaurant administrator to review your role. If you are in support mode, open the tenant from Platform › Restaurants.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: The route you tried to open does not exist or is no longer available.
not_found.helper: Check the address or return to the main panel. If the link came from the menu, the module may not be enabled for your restaurant yet.

method_not_allowed.title: Method not allowed
method_not_allowed.description: This URL does not accept the kind of request you used (for example GET instead of POST).
method_not_allowed.helper: Go back or open the page from the app menu instead of a bookmarked or shared link.

server_error.title: Server error
server_error.description: An unexpected problem occurred while processing your request.
server_error.helper: Try again in a few moments. If the error persists, contact your restaurant support or system administrator.

pwa.chromium_body: One tap adds the icon to your home screen, like a native app.
pwa.ios_chrome_body: Chrome, Instagram, or WhatsApp cannot install the app. Copy the link, open it in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.
pwa.ios_safari_step1: Tap Share (square with arrow ↑) at the bottom in Safari.
pwa.ios_safari_step2: Scroll and tap Add to Home Screen.
pwa.ios_safari_step3: Confirm with Add. The icon stays on your home screen.
pwa.android_step1: In Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
pwa.android_step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
